title: TestFlight, App Store Connect, and the review that rejects you

videos.script: The last lesson is the one between your archive and somebody's phone. {{connect}} It all happens in App Store Connect, which needs the paid membership. So nothing in this lesson was run. It is read from Apple's own pages, as they stood on the thirtieth of October. {{record}} First the record: a name, the bundle identifier, and a build new enough for Apple's minimums. {{testflight}} Then TestFlight. A hundred internal testers at once, and up to ten thousand external ones, after one review. {{listing}} Then the listing and the privacy label, which have to describe the app that was sent. {{review}} Then App Review, against a public document. Most submissions are answered within a day or two. {{rejection}} A rejection names a guideline. You read it, reply or fix, and send a higher build number. {{three}} And last, the same planner three ways: SwiftUI here, Compose and React Native beside it. The tools differ. The shape is the same.
